title: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation Declares Quarterly Common Stock Dividend and Preferred Stock Dividend

# Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation Declares Quarterly Common Stock Dividend and Preferred Stock Dividend


October 29, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c27d5d738249c87b31db79400c827d2c/atlanticunionbank/news/2026-10-29_Atlantic_Union_Bankshares_Corporation_Declares_226.pdf)


RICHMOND, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- The Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation (the “Company”) has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share of common stock, which is a $0.03, or an 8.1%, increase from the dividend in the third quarter of 2026 and the dividend in the fourth quarter of 2025. Based on the Company’s common stock closing price of $39.26 on October 28, 2026, the dividend yield is approximately 4.1%. The common stock dividend is payable on November 27, 2026 to common shareholders of record as of November 13, 2026.


The Board also declared a quarterly dividend on the outstanding shares of the Company’s 6.875% Perpetual Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, Series A (the “Series A preferred stock”). The Series A preferred stock is represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/400th ownership interest in a share of Series A preferred stock. The dividend of $171.88 per share (equivalent to $0.43 per outstanding depositary share) is payable on December 1, 2026 to holders of record as of November 16, 2026.


**About Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation**


Headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation (NYSE: AUB) is the holding company for Atlantic Union Bank. Atlantic Union Bank has branches and ATMs located in Virginia, Maryland, North Carolina and Washington D.C. Certain non-bank financial services affiliates of Atlantic Union Bank include: Atlantic Union Equipment Finance, Inc., which provides equipment financing; AUB Investments, Inc., which provides investment services; and Atlantic Union Capital Markets, Inc., which provides capital market services.
